title: Good Company
text: Good Company. I was disappointed with the first blender I received, it didn’t chop ice frozen veggies or fruits very well.  The company sent me a new blender. They truly want their customers to be happy.  New blender works better, doesn’t completely chop as I hoped it would but definitely better.

product_metadata.title: Portable Blender for Shakes and Smoothies, OBERLY Personal Travel Blender for Protein with 4000mAh USB Rechargeable Battery, Crush Ice, Frozen Fruit and Drinks, 18 oz Mini Travel Cup
features: Upgraded Unique Safety Design: Single-button operation makes this personal blender quick and easy to use. Press twice the switch to start blending and it will prevent misoperation. The portable blender has a unique safety design, which can work normally only when the jar and the base are attached compactly. Built-in safety features prevent overheating and overcharging, extending the life of it.

Upgraded More Powerful: This powerful battery-operated portable blender was designed with 6-point stainless steel blades and 150W strong power motor. It's easy to crush ice, frozen fruit, leafy greens and more into smoothies within 30 seconds flat. Build-in USB rechargeable 4000mAh battery, 20-25 cups of juice can be squeezed on a full charge. It can be charged by power bank, laptop, car charger or USB charger.

Upgraded Large Capacity: With its 18 oz capacity, the portable blender 3 holds 25% more than the original blender in a sleek and compact design. Measurement markings on the jar make it easy to follow your mouth-watering recipes or to create your own. The anti-slip design at the bottom will not move anywhere or fall out. Made from high-quality BPA free and PCTG food grade material. Perfect for shakes and smoothies, protein shaker, juice, yogurt, salad dressings etc.

Upgraded Waterproof Design & Easy to Clean: Adopting waterproof technology, it can effectively prevent water from entering the base of the portable blender during cleaning and causing engine damage. The personal blender can clean itself, just add a drop of soap, a bit of water, press twice the switch to start automatic cleaning. The portable blender cup is detachable — easy to clean, easy to flush. Remember not to immerse the personal blender in the water for safety concerns.

Goes Wherever You Go: The smoothie blender serves up big blender power on the go. We created the personal blender so you can make anything you want, anywhere in the world. It's easy and convenient to use at home, at office, at the gym, in the car, in the camping, at the beach, outdoors. It helps you live healthier while keeping your energy level sky-high.
